//十小时游玩更新 作者我真想问问你你自己玩无尽模式能打过吗，西风撑到34分钟给我出两条龙一个史莱姆两个刺球，一屏的boss你自己清理得过来吗？我70的血一瞬间就没了，真吐了 好评够多了，我写点负面的 游戏创意是非常非常有意思的，窗口的扩展/Boss的出现方式/简单的几何画面但不失流畅的动画，以及随机元素，至少我玩了七个小时还是有爽到 接下来都是我认为某种程度上毁了这款游戏[b] 中后期 [/b]的点 1.升级机制太过随机。中后期敌人巨量增多的情况下某些升级是必要的（子弹增量，穿透等），但最重要的升级需要的经验倍数是疯狂增长的，斩杀敌人的收入却一直不算多。更离谱的是当我无尽模式30分钟左右后，尽管大部分升级都到了20级左右，有很多升级嗯是刷新不出来，反而是不停地给一些一次性道具，我真的是服气。 2.缺少最关键的道具：经验吸收范围。到中后期满屏幕经验需要我去捡，但我竟然要么靠自己移动过去吸收贼小一个范围，要么靠刷出来一次性道具？！就连吸血鬼幸存者好歹都给了一个吸收的被动可选。这样的结果就是中后期你必须不停地移动来吸收经验，然后费半天劲都没法升级，但敌人涌过来的数量是完全离谱的。 3.BOSS设计/角色不平衡。游戏一共有五个表boss：瞬移刺球，大长龙，史莱姆，窗口笑脸怪，光球。但游戏中的近战角色既没有移动速度加成也没有血量加成，我就想知道作者怎么想的要我去近身砍那个龙？还有那个b史莱姆，不仅是会分裂两次，喷出来的毒液踩上去还会扣血，然后我还要用我微弱的火力去打小怪，作者你是不是觉得自己很幽默？ 4.完全缺失的局外成长。本身游戏难度就是很大的，或许是作者有意为之，我觉得尚可原谅。但没有任何局外增长（永久血上限，经验获取，攻击等）+离谱的难度+随机的升级选项让游戏体验变得很差，很多时候前期随机不到重要的升级怪就变多了，完全就是靠运气。 5.无尽模式没有后期体验。同上所说，所有的因素加到一起到最后就是在无尽模式几十分钟后游戏体验降到负分。火力不足小怪血变厚让你打不死怪脑门出汗，全屏幕跑路但是收集不到经验让你急得要死，两个Boss一起出现让你大呼我草，升级选项一直给你刷那个b一次性道具让你莫名其妙，人家吸血鬼幸存者是开头谨慎后期爽玩，你这游戏到后面就只剩折磨的份。 综上，挺好玩的，但 [h1] ♿你老惦记刷你那一次性道具干啥玩意儿 ♿[/h1]

windowkill is a pretty good arena battler for the first few hours. it has a creative concept, fun and challenging gameplay, and decent sound design. sadly, it quickly succumbs to performance issues and lag, because the way it chooses to scale difficulty is "spawn more enemies." i wish the upgrades allowed more meaningful choices. the decision to track each upgrade's price separately incentivizes "builds" which spread tokens evenly into all of them. not much thought has to go into what upgrades you buy. id like to see a larger pool of perks which could be selected from when starting a run, upgrades which remove specific other upgrades from the shop, the ability to purge an upgrade from the shop that you don't want any more levels in, and generally more systems which allow you to create a distinct build each run. ultimately the game's biggest flaw is performance. the game doesn't scale in an elegant way- it increases the difficulty by simply spamming more and more enemies, which inevitably overwhelms the pc, not the player. lag and fps drops end runs before the enemies have a chance to. windowkill is not a finished game. it was created based off a cool idea, which the demo showed off very nicely. but this version doesn't follow thru and optimize or build off of the demo in any meaningful way. there are more enemy types and abilities, but none of them really take the "shoot-em-up in multiple windows" in a new or interesting direction, and none of them are capable of posing a challenge in a >30fps environment.

I acknowledge that your game is relatively creative; however, your engineering capabilities do not support that creativity. The game seems unable to save progress (or auto-save), yet it frequently lags and crashes while I am fully engaged in play. I have been concentrating on leveling up to level eight to unlock new characters, but I have failed to do so after four attempts due to crashes. Each restart is incredibly frustrating, and I am extremely dissatisfied, hence the negative review.Furthermore, I have played many games, and I find your numerical settings and game difficulty to be quite unreasonable. I hope you will refine these aspects, as the game feels more like a work-in-progress. You are fortunate to have seized an interesting concept, and while I will refrain from requesting a refund due to my investment in its collection, the negative review will remain here.
